reactInputSetter.description: Type into React-controlled inputs by using the native HTMLInputElement value setter
reactInputSetter.note: Required because React controls input state. Direct .value assignment does not trigger React updates.

findPanelElement.description: Find action/connector items in the panel by walking DOM for own text content
findPanelElement.note: Own text (text nodes directly in the element, not nested children) is more reliable than textContent which includes all descendant text.

verifyTriggerPlaced.description: Check that a trigger was successfully placed on the canvas

addTrigger.description: Add a trigger to start the flow
steps: Click [aria-label="Add a trigger"] on the canvas — opens the panel
Type trigger name into input[aria-label="Search for an action or connector"] using React setter
Wait 2500ms for search results
Click the desired trigger from the results (walk panel for own text match)
Wait 4000ms for trigger to be placed on canvas

addAction.description: Add an action step to the flow
steps: Click [aria-label*="Insert a new action"] (the + button between steps)
Type action name into search input using React setter
Wait 2500ms for search results
Click the desired action from the results
Wait 3000ms for action to be placed
Click on the action node in the canvas to expand its configuration form
Fill in required fields using React setter technique for each input
For dropdowns, click the dropdown then click the option
For dynamic content, click the lightning bolt icon then select the value
For expressions, click 'fx' then type the expression
Click #saveFlow
Wait 3000ms for confirmation toast
Click #testFlow to open the test panel
Select 'Manually' radio button if prompted
Click 'Test' or 'Run flow' button
Wait for completion — green checkmarks appear on each step
Click #checkFlow
Review error/warning list in the panel that opens
Click individual errors to navigate to the problematic action
